description: The first run of `custom-snapshot-inline` (B23e, D128), captured: `toMatchTrimmedInlineSnapshot` calls jest-snapshot 30.5.2's `toMatchInlineSnapshot` with its `this`, and a local run (`--ci=false`) with nothing stored writes each inline snapshot into the test file at the custom matcher's call (`prettierPath: null`, so Babel's reprint alone) and the `toMatchSnapshot` beside them into the .snap: 3 snapshots written, each counted in the totals (`added`). The same `setup.ts` and test file as `custom-snapshot-inline`. One file, one worker.
